name: Άργιλος
evidence: Argilos is a clay/sand beach type (named for the argilos-clay used for natural spa); Greek guides describe it as an ammoudia, not pebble/rock. Locality note: the well-documented Argilos-with-clay is the East-Crete/Xerokampos one; the Chania/SW-coast beach at these coords is same clay-sand class. Our label (άμμος) and OSM (SAND) agree.

name: Κυανή Ακτή
evidence: Grecorama/Terrabook: Kiani Akti at Kalyves/Souda (Apokoronas, Chania, 17km E of Chania) is a large sandy beach with fine sand (ψιλή άμμος) and shallow water. Coords match Kalyves. Both our label (βράχια) and OSM (ROCKS) are wrong; our own ourTypes [fine_sand,coarse_sand] were actually correct.

name: Παραλία Κουταλάς
evidence: Discover Crete / Vamos Village: Koutalas at Kokkino Chorio (Cape Drapano, Apokoronas, ~27km E of Chania) 'έχει βότσαλα και μεγάλες πέτρες' with a rocky seabed and a small sand strip. Coords match. Predominant surface is pebbles/large stones — not the ROCKS both our label (βράχια) and OSM claim.

name: Γούβες
evidence: cretanbeaches/okaycrete: Kato Gouves (18km E of Heraklion) has fine sand (λεπτή άμμος) and shallow water. Coords match Gouves. Both our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) are wrong; ourTypes [fine_sand] was correct.

name: Σταλίδα
evidence: explorecrete/cretanbeaches: Stalida (Stalis, near Malia, Heraklion) is a ~3km organized beach of fine sand (ψιλή άμμος) with shallow water. Coords match. Both our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) are wrong; ourTypes [fine_sand] was correct.

name: Λίμνη
evidence: cretanbeaches: the Skaleta/Sfakaki coast (Almyros gulf, ~12km NE of Rethymno) at these coords is golden fine sand (χρυσή ψιλή άμμος), a Caretta nesting shore. Disambiguated to the Rethymno gulf (lng 24.688 is E of Rethymno town, not Georgioupoli). Our label (άμμος) and OSM (SAND) agree.

name: Παραλία Ανατολικά
evidence: cretanbeaches/originalcrete: these coords (35.148/24.500) are the Agios Pavlos–Akoumiani Gialia dune coast of S Rethymno (Ammolofoi/Alatsogkremnoi), described as expansive αμμουδιά with sand dunes. Disambiguated to Agios Pavlos (Sachtouria), not Plakias. Our label (άμμος) and OSM (SAND) agree.

name: Παραλία Κεφάλα
evidence: cretanbeaches/originalcrete: Kefala is the NW end of the Akoumiani Gialia / Agios Pavlos sandy-dune stretch (S Rethymno), a sandy shore (with some scattered pebbles near the Agios Pavlos hamlet). Coords ~1km from id 690, same dune system. Our label (άμμος) and OSM (SAND) agree.

name: Σκίνος
evidence: cretanbeaches: Skinos, the second beach of Plakias (Sellia, W of the fishing shelter), 'has sand and many small rocks/stones, ideal for snorkeling; organized near the village, rockier to the west.' Sand base with pebbles/small rocks = mixed, not the pure PEBBLES our label (βότσαλα) and OSM state.

name: Άμμος Ξερόκαμπου
evidence: cretanbeaches/originalcrete: this is the sandy sector of Xerokampos (Siteia, Lasithi) — the name itself is 'Ammos' (sand) and the main beaches here (Mazida Ammos) are white/golden sand. Both our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) wrong; ourTypes [fine_sand] correct.

name: Ποταμός Ξερόκαμπου
evidence: cretanbeaches: the 'Potamos' beach at the mouth of the Katsounaki gorge (Xerokampos, Siteia) is a beach 'με μεγάλα βότσαλα' (large pebbles) with a rocky seabed, not family-friendly. Coords match. Our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) agree; ourTypes [fine_sand] was the outlier.

name: Μικρή παραλία
evidence: hotelpotos/afrodite-studios: ~150m from the central Pefkari beach (S Thasos, near Potos) there is 'a second, pebbly and completely unorganized beach' — the small beach at these coords. Our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) agree; ourTypes [fine_sand] was the outlier.

name: Πευκάρι
evidence: thassos-view/tripadvisor: Pefkari (S Thasos) 'combines soft sand with small pebbles' — sand is the main surface with pebbles/small rocks at the edges (aqua shoes advised). Coords match. Genuinely mixed, not the pure PEBBLES our label (βότσαλα) and OSM claim.

name: Καρνάγιο
evidence: thassos-view/karnagiothassos: Karnagio at the end of Thasos-town (Limenas) old harbour sits 'at the edge of the last rock' — a rocky swim spot/beach bar, not sandy. Coords match Limenas. Both our label (άμμος) and OSM (SAND) wrong; ourTypes [rocks,pebbles] closer.

name: Κλίσμα
evidence: Greeka: Klisma (near Skala Kalirachi, W coast Thasos, 22km SW of Limenas) is 'a beautiful pebbled beach... covered with large smooth pebbles' (aqua shoes recommended). Coords match. Our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) agree; ourTypes [fine_sand] was the outlier.

name: Σκάλα Πρίνου
evidence: thassos-view/go-thassos: Skala Prinou (Dasyllion, N Thasos, 15km from port) is a white/fine sandy beach (blue flag), shallow and waveless. Coords match. Both our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) wrong; ourTypes [fine_sand] correct.

name: Δεή πλους
evidence: Name is garbled/untraceable; coords sit in the Plataria bay (Thesprotia) where the 1.5km main beach is golden sand but nearby coves (Gata/Kalami) are coarse/fine pebbles. Could not pin this exact spot to one source, so retain our label; our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) already agree.

name: Γουβιά
evidence: discover-corfu: Gouvia Beach (sheltered bay, 8km N of Corfu Town) is 'mostly small pebbles and shingle, with some patches of coarse sand... not a fine sand beach.' Coords match. Our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) agree.

name: Αρκουδάκι
evidence: paxosinfo/greekvillaholidays: Arkoudaki (N Paxos, near Lakka) is a pebble beach with a tented area by flat rocks for sunbathing; the swimmable beach surface is pebbles (some call it 'rocky' for the flanking flat rocks). Coords match. Our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) agree.

name: Δεύτερη Σπιάντζα
evidence: cycladia/sandee: the Paxos 'spiantzes' near Gaios are small pebbly beaches enclosed by low rocky cliffs; Spiantza is 'a small pebbly beach' with translucent water. Coords match (SE of Gaios). Our label (βότσαλα) and OSM (PEBBLES) agree.
